description: Retrieve invoices, receipts, return invoices, and quote documents from Chirak store with optional filtering by type or status.

limit.description: Number of documents to return (default 50, max 100).

sale_number.description: Optional filter by associated order number (e.g. 'ORD-1004').

type.description: Optional filter by document type: 'invoice', 'receipt', 'return_invoice', 'proforma', or 'quote'.

name: list_documents

data.description: Result data payload from Chirak API.
